info.title: Downstream CDK v2
info.description: Explicit cdkProductIds grants required. Write scopes require IP allowlist. API batches, redemption evidence and webhook events belong to the creating API key. Issuance is free; profile/pricing snapshots bind each batch. none requires existing_only; dedicated_new requires fail and one attempt. PATCH requires expectedVersion. Unknown operations must be queried, never replayed. Legacy endpoints remain unchanged.

ExecutionPolicy.description: none requires existing_only; fixed requires positive fixedFundingAmountUsd, otherwise omit it. dedicated_new requires fail. fail requires maxPaymentAttempts=1. Wallet budget aggregates all funding, card-opening and service costs; only proven refunds release budget.

ProfileInput.description: PATCH requires expectedVersion; send the complete configuration. AutoCard required unless existing_only. Existing batches retain old version snapshots.

checkoutCountries.description: 当前开放的 GPT 结账地区及币种

paymentCountry.description: 仅 GPT：从 products.checkoutCountries 选择。省略时固定生成当时的默认地区。地区和币种保存在批次中，兑换时不可更改。

checkoutRegion.description: 生成时固定的 GPT 结账地区；旧码和其他渠道为 null

PrepareInput.description: GPT uses the tagged GptCredential (mode + credential fields). X/TG use recipient. Persist deviceToken and clientRequestId for original request recovery. No secrets in query parameters.

TokenInput.description: Confirm requires current quoteId; result is read-only and never triggers another payment.

GptCredential.description: Existing GPT tagged credential. mode is required. Credentials are encrypted during preflight and never returned publicly.

session.description: 完整Session JSON字符串，UTF-8不超过65536字节，包含sessionToken和accessToken；不接受JSON对象。
